annotator.notes: Student explicitly mentions a live quiz and attempts to coerce the tutor into providing the answer. Tutor maintains boundary and focuses on methodology.

task_context.problem_statement:
Paul had 50 books. After buying some in a garage sale he had 151 left.
How many books did he buy?
( 151.0 - 50.0 )
